input.rationale: Section 13.5 gives Corio ownership of the Developments it creates and includes a Commerce One assignment and a pre-existing IP reservation, but it reverses direction whenever Commerce One supports the Developments on an ongoing basis: Commerce One then retains all ownership rights in Corio-created work product with no licence back. That is walk-away territory (assignment of Customer IP to Vendor) and fails the fallback as well, since Corio receives no perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to the work product it loses. There is also no licence to Commerce One IP embedded in the Developments, no statement that Corio's data remains Corio's (Commerce One processes data through the MarketSite.net Service and support), and ownership of jointly developed Software enhancements is left open. We have therefore made the shortest edits at the preferred level: delete the ownership-reversal carve-out, add a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free embedded-IP licence and a Corio data-ownership sentence limiting Commerce One's use to providing the Software and services, and confirm that no IP is jointly owned.

proposal.summary: Corio owns Developments outright; add embedded-IP licence back, Corio data ownership, and no joint ownership
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We must own the work product we create, so we have deleted the carve-out that hands ownership of Corio-created Developments to Commerce One whenever it supports them, and added a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free licence to any Commerce One IP embedded in the Developments. We have also confirmed Corio's ownership of its data (with Commerce One's use limited to providing the Software and services) and that no IP is jointly owned.

ops.oldText: Ownership of intellectual property rights to any enhancements, modifications or derivative works to the Software itself which may be developed jointly by the parties or solely by Corio shall be negotiated by the parties prior to the start of any such development work.
ops.newText: Ownership of intellectual property rights to any enhancements, modifications or derivative works to the Software itself which may be developed jointly by the parties or solely by Corio shall be negotiated by the parties prior to the start of any such development work, provided that no intellectual property shall be jointly owned by the parties.

ops.text: Commerce One grants Corio a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free license to use any Commerce One intellectual property embedded in the Developments. Corio retains all right, title and interest in all data belonging to, supplied by or processed for Corio or its Customers, and any Commerce One license in such data is limited to processing that data solely to provide the Software, the MarketSite.net Service and Maintenance and Support under this Agreement.
